unit.why: A compilation of homiletic and kabbalistic quotations (Or la-Shamayim, Berit Menuhah, Toldot Adam, Torah Hayyim) on later generations surpassing earlier ones and on faith in tzaddikim; it contains no narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: Final words 'מענין גזירה' are a heading for the next section, which begins in the next division
